review_scope: apps/api/index.ts comparison endpoint and authentication/project-grant path

preliminary_findings.finding: Comparison selector changes do not increment releaseComparisonSequence or clear comparison state. A delayed request can complete after the user changes away from its pair and back, and its response can pass the current project/token/session/refresh/sequence guards. This does not meet the acceptance requirement that pair changes discard results.
preliminary_findings.location: apps/web/src/app.jsx compareReleases and ReleaseScreen base/candidate select onChange handlers

positive_observations: API route has authenticated prehandler; project access hook checks current local credential and explicit project grant for this POST route.
Transaction locks scoped project and release rows in sorted ID order; archived project is accepted for reading.
Both release rows receive database-side shape and size checks before the payload SELECT.
Malformed retained references return fixed NOT_FOUND; verified parser profile and manifest are required; pair compatibility checks repository ID, folder, and parser profile.
Self-comparison is structurally supported by deduplicating requested IDs and comparing the mapped release with itself.
Comparison helper uses arbitrary-length digit-string ordering without JavaScript Number; React renders retained content as escaped text.
No write statements or target/credential access were observed in the comparison route/helper.
limitations: This is a point-in-time preliminary review of actively edited uncommitted source, not exact-head or frozen-manifest approval.
Source may have changed immediately after capture; hashes identify only the source bytes observed at capture.
No tests, build, runtime security tooling, external GitHub security scan, or full adversarial database exercise was run.
This record does not approve T25 completion, merge, distribution, or any security-gate exception. Fresh QA/security review at the frozen final head remains mandatory.
